## DVRDesk Native is here

**DVRDesk Native** is a ground-up rewrite of DVRDesk with a much more reliable playback engine. It's the recommended version going forward. 1.x will keep getting fixes, but new features land in Native.

**[Download DVRDesk Native](https://github.com/jay3702/DVRDesk/releases?q=native-v&expanded=true)** (Windows and Linux)

Your servers and preferences come with you:
- **Windows and Linux:** open DVRDesk Native, go to **Settings**, and click **Import Automatically**. It reads this app's settings directly, and this app can stay installed.
- **Or manually:** in this app, open **Settings → Migrate to DVRDesk Native** and click **Copy Settings for Migration**, then paste into DVRDesk Native's Settings screen.

## What's new in this 1.x release

- New **Migrate to DVRDesk Native** section in Settings for copying your settings to Native.
- The update check works again. Since DVRDesk Native started publishing releases, 1.x had stopped reporting new 1.x versions.
- Subtitle files on an unreachable network share no longer freeze the app. The read now times out after 10 seconds.
- A recording that stalls before it starts playing now shows a closeable error instead of spinning forever.
- Stalled stream requests now time out and retry instead of hanging, and cancelled requests are properly released.
- A corrupt segment can no longer send the player into a rapid recovery loop that crashed playback on Linux.
